title: Platform contract envelope
description: Wraps every shared contract document. Identifies the contract family by namespaced identifier and semantic version, carries the producer timestamp, and holds the contract-specific payload. Additional top-level keys beyond contract, generated_at, and payload are forward-compatible non-security metadata.

contract.description: Namespaced contract identifier and semantic version, e.g. 'platform.identity-subject/0.1.0'.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at which the producer emitted the document.

payload.description: Contract-specific data. Validated against the per-contract schema referenced by the contract identifier.
